also_known_as: Ku Klux Klan Act, Third Enforcement Act
source_description: Statutes at Large, Volume 17, pages 13-14. PDF scan of enrolled act. Section 2 spans most of page 13 second column and all of page 14 first column.
transcription_method: Manual transcription from PDF scan of original Statutes at Large page, same primary source used for §1983 origin.
notes: The original Section 2 contained both criminal penalties (fine/imprisonment) and a civil action for damages. The criminal provisions were later separated. The civil action became R.S. §1980, then 42 USC §1985. The 'go in disguise upon the public highway' language is a literal description of the Klan.
